_notes: Image models read a negation as the thing it names: 'do not recolour' recolours, 'no squint' squints, 'not glowing' glows. State the positive instead (or leave it to the negative prompt, which the Qwen workflows have). tools/art/negation_audit.py scans every generated positive prompt with these rules. command = an instruction to not do something; flip = a known qualifier that names the unwanted thing; review = any other no/not/nothing/without, counted but not failing. allow = places where a negative is the only tool (a video model has no negative prompt) or the text is not ours to change.
flip: \bno (?:pale areas|gap between|heavy lipstick|glow|light spilling|backlight|squint|breeze|footwear|shoes|shine|bump|marks or tan lines|paint|metal|metallic sheen|magical or glowing)\b

allow.why: video prompts: the video model has no negative prompt, so 'no cuts', 'no subtitles' and the like are the only way to say it
gameplay card art is drafted from each card's name and lore, which the card owns (data/cards); edit the card, not the art
brand art is text-to-image; 'no text' and 'no frame' belong to the title and plate designs
